records.title: Compensation to Victims of Flight Crash.
details: a to b: For the remaining 7 injured individuals, interim compensation is at various stages of verification. The final compensation process has also been initiated for the individuals who have received interim compensation.

records.title: Coffee promotion and Development Bill.
details: a to e: The Government has carried out wide consultations on the draft Coffee (Promotion and Development) Bill inter alia including putting the draft Bill in public domain and consolations with various growers associations, exporters associations, industry stakeholders & related Ministries/Departments of Government of India. The Bill has not yet been finalized for introduction in the Parliament.

records.title: Social Security of gig and platform workers.
details: Recognizing the contribution of gig workers of online platforms, the Union Government in its Budget announcement made on 01.02.2025, proposed to register them on e-Sharm portal, arrange for their identity cards and provide health care under Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Aarogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY) health scheme.
